svg.title: The insert request through the pipeline
svg.desc: Flow of the insert from the bay through the dispatcher and the scheduler stages to the validation failure and back to the dispatcher, which drops the job.

g.text: Where the insert fails and why nothing recovers

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The stall is chosen at stage 2 without regard to AGVs; validation, two stages later, is the first check that counts the AGV on the charger. The response is a success with every job in error, so the dispatcher retries, then

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: drops the INSERT job. No event re-creates it.
